title: Apache Struts2 S2-048 OGNL Injection (Struts 1 Plugin)
description: The Struts2 2.3.32 showcase application, vulnerable to S2-048 (CVE-2017-9791): the Struts 1 plugin integration page (Save Gangster) passes the submitted name into an action message key, which is evaluated as an OGNL expression and runs commands.
question: Exploit S2-048 through the showcase's Struts 1 integration page to run commands and read /ctf/flag.
